description: Failure flow: a Bash tool call fails (missing file), then a diagnostic `ls -la` succeeds.
notes: KEY OBSERVED BEHAVIOR: the first Bash call exits non-zero and has NO matching PostToolUse. In Claude Code 2.1.198 a failed Bash tool call does not fire PostToolUse; the failure is only observable as a PreToolUse without a matching PostToolUse (correlated by tool_use_id), plus the Stop message. This is exactly the observation gap ADR-0001 documents. Fixtures must preserve this asymmetry, not paper over it (ADR-0002 honesty).
